reason: £18 for 300g is steep when I can get a 500g-plus tub of grass-fed collagen on Amazon for about the same, often on offer. The halal bit is nice but I'm not paying a premium and chasing a £30 free-delivery threshold for a brand I've never heard of.
objection: I could get a bigger tub cheaper on Amazon, and a 4.8 from reviews on their own site doesn't tell me much.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it on Amazon or in Holland & Barrett at a proper intro offer, say under £12 a pouch, with reviews I can trust.
